acceptance_criteria.description: An LLM1 call uses only an intact eligible versioned PAPER decision context and sends strict JSON Schema structured output with bounded completion length/timeout and provider parameter support required.

Injected-transport tests cover malformed output, unsupported schema, timeout, transient failures with at most one retry, non-retryable 4xx without retry, exhausted credits, and typed terminal no-action failures without any live request.

Each successful or failed attempt is persisted with stage/run/cycle/context identities, requested/resolved model/provider, generation ID/fingerprint where returned, normalized input reference, parsed output or typed failure, latency, token usage, reported cost, and sanitized evidence.

OpenRouter credentials are sent only to the validated official OpenRouter HTTPS endpoint and are absent from persisted fields, API responses, logs, and exception messages; the model receives no tools or order authority.

Any stored-contract change is represented in a new append-only migration and matching Drizzle schema; additive migration application and stage-record persistence/retrieval are verified without resetting existing local data.

evidence.known_current_stage_runs_contract: Existing stage_runs stores IDs, stage/status, provider/request ID, model, input/output, failure_code, and timestamps; it lacks explicit stage version, fingerprint, latency, token counts, and cost columns.
evidence.known_local_test_seam: Node fetch can be injected so hermetic tests simulate OpenRouter without credentials; LOCAL_TEST_MODE refuses configured provider credentials.
